title: miRNA RPM Normalization
text: miRPM R package transparent reproducible analysis microRNA sequencing count data using reads per million (RPM) normalization. package provides modular workflow : RPM normalization explicit library-size handling. Abundance prevalence filtering. Non-parametric analysis group differences. Multiple-testing correction effect-size estimation. Static interactive expression plots. Optional Excel, HTML PNG output.

title: Perform non-parametric differential-expression analysis — perform_statistical_tests
text: Performs rank-based differential-expression analysis normalized miRNA expression matrix. Two-group comparisons use Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon rank-sum test. Comparisons involving three groups use Kruskal-Wallis test followed Dunn post-hoc comparisons.
